messages: Ava (Design): quick check on the batch vectors preview — on narrow view the legend and action buttons wrap weirdly. thinking: make the legend part of a sticky header or collapse into an icon that expands? Zach (Eng): sticky header is simpler to implement and keeps actions visible. collapsing into a separate panel could hide important context though. does sticky break keyboard order? Carmen (A11y): sticky is okay if legend items are focusable and have clear accessible names. right now the color swatches are decorative with no aria-label. Ava (Design): plan: visible text labels next to swatches + aria-labels for each swatch. also add a high-contrast toggle that switches to text+shape markers. Jon (PM): product note: keep export and bulk actions together on the header so users can export from the same spot they run previews. last time we split them and saw support tickets. Zach (Eng): header layout proposal: left = legend toggle, center = density control, right = export + bulk actions. I'll prototype. Liam (ML): rerank score needs context. We display "0.83" now with no range. can we add a hint like "(0-1)" or a tooltip? non-ML users get confused. Ava (Design): tooltip copy: "Rerank score (0-1): higher = more relevant". Carmen, any screen reader concerns? Carmen (A11y): tooltips alone are inaccessible. prefer an sr-only explanatory node that `aria-describedby` can reference. e.g., `Rerank score 0 to 1; higher is more relevant`. avoid transient tooltips as the only mechanism. Zach (Eng): will add sr-only element. question: do we need a live region when re-rank updates scores? could annoy screen reader users. Carmen (A11y): avoid `role="status"` for every small update. use a polite live region only when a row meaningfully changes and summarize: "Row 3: score increased to 0.85". Ava (Design): export modal copy tweak: change "Download vectors" to "Export vectors (CSV)" and subtext: "Includes id, truncated vector dims, rerank_score" — clearer expectations. Jon (PM): also add warning if export > 10k rows and recommend sampling. support saw timeouts previously. Liam (ML): sampling options suggestion: dropdown with First N, Random sample, Stratified by score. default to Random 1000. include short inline descriptions. Zach (Eng): big perf note: rendering 10k rows in preview kills the DOM. let's cap preview at 100 rows and show a banner: "Previewing 100 of 10,000 vectors — export will include all unless sampled." Ava (Design): banner copy: "Previewing 100 of 10,000 vectors. Export all or choose a sample." Banner should be role=note and keyboard dismissible. Carmen? Carmen (A11y): yes. close button needs `aria-label="Dismiss preview notice"` and banner must not trap focus. make sure focus returns to a logical place after dismiss. Zach (Eng): accessibility nit: color-only legend fails contrast. add text labels or shape markers. Ava (Design): update legend to include short text next to swatches and optional icon (dot/square/triangle) as non-color cue. Jon (PM): analytics ask: can we track density toggle (compact/comfortable) as a user preference event? would be useful. Zach (Eng): yes, will emit analytics event on toggle. Liam (ML): small UI: vector dims show as "[768]" — for long dims we should show "[768 dims]" and on hover reveal full detail to avoid overflow. Ava (Design): microcopy for hover: "Dimension count = vector length; used for model compatibility." Carmen (A11y): hover-only info isn't accessible. ensure the same text is available via keyboard focus with `aria-describedby`. ui-bot: deploy-preview updated for branch `design/batch-preview-legend` — staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/batch-preview-legend Zach (Eng): can folks test staging with macOS VoiceOver + Windows NVDA? I'll attach a checklist to the PR. Ava (Design): I'll run a keyboard pass and update the mock with these TODOs: 1) accessible legend names, 2) dismissible preview banner, 3) export modal copy + sampling dropdown. Jon (PM): timeline: ship next week behind feature flag. blockers? Carmen (A11y): blocking until aria-describedby and live region approach in PR. otherwise ok. Zach (Eng): opening PR tonight. Ava (Design): thanks — I'll add notes to the design doc and ping when mocks are ready. :thumbsup:
